Prov. to XXX, 26</cite> <he>זה מדי כשם שהש׳ יש בו וכ׳</he> ‘the conies &c.’, this refers to Media, as the cony has the symptoms of cleanness (being a ruminant) and also those of uncleanness &c.; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13">Lev.
